narrative.overview: Playerinyo stages an owned music library as a room of projected sleeves. Carbon-black structure lowers visual noise, graphite light fields establish destinations and listening context, and white marks action and current state. Album art is the only full-spectrum material; danger and fault states alone use red.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite light fields against carbon-black structure.
Square, nearly unframed album and playlist sleeves.
Paper-white typography with compact neutral-gray support text.
White reserved for decisive actions, active destinations, focus, and progress.
One scrolling content stage beside a persistent listening studio.

rules.name: The Field, Not Confetti Rule
rules.body: Graphite owns complete regions. Do not scatter gray chips across a flat dashboard to simulate hierarchy.

rules.name: The White Means State Rule
rules.body: White communicates action, focus, progress, or current state. It is not ambient wallpaper.

rules.name: The Red Means Trouble Rule
rules.body: Red appears only for destructive actions, errors, and fault states.

rules.name: The Artwork Owns Variety Rule
rules.body: Full-spectrum color comes from the listener's covers; application chrome remains monochrome.

rules.name: The One Stage Rule
rules.body: Home, Library, playlists, Tag Health, search, statistics, album detail, and playlist detail are mutually exclusive central views.

rules.name: The Persistent Studio Rule
rules.body: Cover, identity, transport, seek, volume, EQ, compact Up Next, Queue, Lyrics, and Now Playing remain reachable while central views change; relaunch restores the complete playback context paused at its saved position.

rules.name: The Sleeve Before Surface Rule
rules.body: Album and playlist containers remain transparent; artwork, type, and one directional shadow provide structure.

dos: Do keep owned album art larger and more varied than application chrome.
Do use broad black-to-graphite fields and reserve white for state and action.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus, drag targets, disabled states, and recoverable startup errors.
Do keep compact Up Next visible while detailed Queue and Lyrics expand on demand.
Do let responsive layouts recompose the three regions instead of clipping them.
donts: Don't restore the wide persistent playlist sidebar or bottom player.
Don't reintroduce Signal Bench metal, amber readouts, screws, keycaps, or hardware labels.
Don't introduce interface color beyond full-spectrum cover art and semantic danger red.
Don't wrap album shelves in same-sized dashboard cards.
Don't use glass blur on stable reading surfaces.
